comments.text: The game's host and the 44 tests that build it do not include src/silhouette or src/calamus, and the game build does not link the Calamus C library. To apply a material Silhouette in WorldApi.SpawnPiece (texture, tint, MeshRenderer.material) the game has to link Amanuensis Calamus, or a baked material list has to be written by the editor.
